method: For each setting: normalize the 1-decimal rounded categorical percentages to 1, then compute H(average distribution) minus average H(setting distribution), assuming equal weight among the six settings. Multiply by 200 for per-eligible-trial power. This does NOT estimate 7000-game selection score.
